subject: Quick alignment: two 30-min demo windows for ClearPath pilot (exec + infra)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearpath.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + two demo windows for pilot

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on the ClearPath pilot goals. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the 30-minute product intro:

- Goal: show a short walkthrough of Redwood inference workflows (hosted + private options) and how caching/batching could move the needle on cost for your tracking pipeline.
- Ask: confirm 2–3 stakeholders to attend (you mentioned an exec and an infra/ML lead).
- Proposed next step: 30-minute product intro + Q&A (no heavy infra deep-dive) this week or next.

I attached a one-pager that highlights the pilot scope. Below are two time windows (all in PST) — please pick the one that works best or propose alternatives:

Option A: Tuesday 22 Jun — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Option B: Wednesday 23 Jun — 2:30–3:00 PM PT

If neither works, tell me two other 30-min blocks and I’ll coordinate. Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Ben (solutions engineer) so he can join for the Q&A.

Attachments: clearpath-pilot-onepager.pdf, pilot-attendee-list.xlsx

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0197

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearpath.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + two demo windows for pilot

Hi Mina — thanks for the clear summary. Option B (Wed 23 Jun 2:30–3:00 PM PT) looks best for us. Attendees we’ll have:

- Alicia Gomez (Head of Product)
- Samir Patel (Lead ML Engineer) — cc’d

We’d like the intro to be product-focused, with 10–15 minutes reserved for an ops/infra question set. If Ben can cover the caching + deployment patterns quickly, that should be perfect.

One quick ask: can you confirm whether the demo will include a brief note on estimated unit cost at 1M tokens/day? That’s something our finance partner will scan during the pilot eval.

Thanks,
Alicia
Director of Product | ClearPath Logistics

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearpath.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + two demo windows for pilot

Perfect — locking Wed 23 Jun 2:30–3:00 PM PT. Calendar invite will follow once you confirm timezone (PT ok).

Quick answers to your questions:
- Yes, Ben will include a short slide on typical unit-cost ranges and which knobs (batching, cache, quantization) move the needle at 1M tokens/day. He won’t run a full TCO model in the 30-min intro but can outline expected tradeoffs and follow up with a simple cost projection tailored to ClearPath after the call.
- For the technical Q&A, Ben (cc’d) — would you like Samir to share any telemetry/throughput numbers ahead of time so we can prepare targeted examples?

Ben, can you confirm you’re available for Wed 23 Jun 2:30–3:00 PM PT and whether you want any materials in advance?

Thanks — I’ll send the invite and include the one-pager + agenda.

Mina

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearpath.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + two demo windows for pilot

On Fri, Jun 18, 2027 at 12:04 PM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben, can you confirm you’re available for Wed 23 Jun 2:30–3:00 PM PT and whether you want any materials in advance?

Yes — I’m available and happy to join. Alicia, if Samir can share a short bullet list of:

- current request rate (reqs/second) or avg tokens per request,
- peak concurrency, and
- whether you’re evaluating hosted vs. private deploys for the pilot,

I’ll prepare a 2-slide appendix with concrete batching/cost examples tuned to those numbers. Otherwise I’ll bring general examples and an outline of rollout options.

I’ve also attached a brief agenda I typically use for a 30-min intro; we can trim or reorder as you prefer.

Attachments: 30min-demo-agenda.pdf

See you Wed — sending the invite now.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
